run_tokenize_cpp_file: run the C++ tokenizer on a source file and print each token type and name to stdout
create_GetTokens_generator: create a generator that yields Token objects for each token found in C++ source code
build_Token_class: build a Token data container with token_type, name, start index, and end index attributes
test_GetString_helper: test the _GetString helper that finds the closing quote of a C++ string literal handling backslash escapes
test_GetChar_helper: test the _GetChar helper that finds the closing quote of a C++ char literal handling backslash escapes
